pages.text: First obtain a filled Taglock Kit:$(li)Use an empty kit on a player.$(li)Sneak-use it in the air to bind it to yourself.$(li)Use it on a bed to bind an online player whose respawn point is that bed.$(br2)Craft the filled kit with an unbound, non-blank poppet. Existing bindings cannot be overwritten.
After you obtained a taglock you can craft it together with an unbound poppet to bind the poppet to the owner of the taglock.
